root_and_children_result_2026_11_23.source: lib/l9.nox and core array/object/stack primitives in lib/inox.ts
causes_repaired: Early make.task stub was compiled into initialize-l9 before actual registration; use late resolution after task/class{ registers the real maker.
maker{ attaches class tag after three user arguments; task maker now consumes class receiver + spawn/fork/parent in correct stack order.
object.! was asserting forwarding area payload length ==1 while valid extensible objects may contain allocator-padded length 2.

array.each{ was missing: indexed arrays need native length/get based iteration, distinct from object.each.
Child registration now retrieves actual parent subtasks/forks arrays and uses array.push with correct receiver/value order.
The task maker no longer hardcodes fork/spawn booleans, and id now has an explicit getter.
